note: The scenarios feature 103 adds to the fixture families of feature 141, inside the scope the catalogue of §O.2 states for them, with only the stub verbs of §O.3 and the surfaces of §O.4 (F141-FR-030). The catalogue row that reserves them reads: "families FX-17, FX-18, FX-19, FX-20, FX-24 | `103-<name>` | 103 | 103 | the verbs of §O.3 | the surfaces of each family | Names that feature 103 reserves for the usage failures of the pass loop and the empty prompt. Not yet named; feature 103 registers each name here when it writes it". This file IS that registration from the side of feature 103; the catalogue of specs/141-parity-oracle/spec.md is the register of scenario names and is written by feature 141, which this feature does not edit — specs/103-proposer-pass/orchestrator-report.md asks for the rows.
catalogue: specs/141-parity-oracle/spec.md, §O.2, the table "Scenarios added after the first set"

scenarios.name: 103-usage-workdir-missing
scenarios.stubs: none is called: the loop ends before any pass starts
scenarios.expectation: exit 1 and the line `proposer.sh: --workdir DIR required (got '<value>')` on standard error; no pass; the transcript holds no record
scenarios.inScope: FX-17 drives the entry point `pass-loop`; the usage failure is the entry point of the same script, before the pass numbering the family exercises. The catalogue reserves the name for exactly this in FX-17 to FX-20 and FX-24
cases: the value is not a directory

scenarios.name: 103-usage-workdir-unenterable
scenarios.expectation: exit 1 with no line of its own: the loop cannot enter the working directory. The directory of the fixture has its execute bit cleared in the template
scenarios.inScope: As `103-usage-workdir-missing`. Prerequisite: the run does not have the effective user id 0, which can enter any directory; otherwise a skip with its reason, as `FX-26/root-sandbox-assertion` does for the other direction

scenarios.name: 103-usage-evidence-missing
scenarios.expectation: exit 1 and the line `proposer.sh: --evidence FILE required` on standard error

scenarios.name: 103-usage-prompt-missing
scenarios.expectation: exit 1 and the line `proposer.sh: --prompt-file FILE required (got '<value>')` on standard error
cases: the path is not a regular file

scenarios.name: 103-usage-flag-without-value
scenarios.expectation: a parameter error and exit 1; the usage text is NOT printed. At the baseline the value of every field is read as `${2:?}`, so a field present without a value ends the shell with its own parameter error
scenarios.inScope: As `103-usage-workdir-missing`. The scenario is the one usage failure that prints no usage text, which is why it is its own scenario and not a case of `103-usage-unknown-arg`

scenarios.name: 103-usage-unknown-arg
scenarios.expectation: exit 1, the line `proposer.sh: unknown arg: <name>` and the usage text, both on standard error
scenarios.inScope: FX-18 is the family of a pass that fails before the harness starts, and it is the family whose covered features hold 124, which cites the usage list. The unknown field is the failure before the harness starts that needs no stub at all

scenarios.name: 103-usage-text
scenarios.expectation: a request with `help` set returns exit 0 and the usage text. The text lists the codes 0, 1, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 and, as at the baseline, does NOT list 3
scenarios.reference: The pass-loop script, lines 23 and 229; the EXIT section of the usage text at lines 116 to 132
scenarios.inScope: FX-18 covers feature 124. This scenario is the entry point of the parity test PT-124-C-057-usage-list of feature 124 (SECOND-PASS-LIST D27): the list of codes in the usage text of the pass loop is read from here and nowhere else

scenarios.name: 103-empty-prompt
scenarios.stubs: none is called: the loop ends before the first pass
scenarios.expectation: exit 1 and the line `proposer.sh: prompt is empty` on standard error. The prompt file of the fixture holds only white space of the C locale (space, tab, newline, vertical tab, form feed, carriage return)
scenarios.inScope: FX-19 is the family of the plain-output path of the start-up, where the pass loop decides before any pass whether it runs at all. The empty-prompt test is the last of those decisions, and the catalogue reserves the name for it
cases: a file of spaces and tabs

scenarios.name: 103-evidence-present
scenarios.stubs: none is called: the loop ends before any prompt is read
scenarios.expectation: exit 0, the event the projection renders as `evidence_present` with `file` set to the base name and `iters` set to 0, and the line `proposer.sh: evidence already exists (<path>); nothing to do.` on standard error. The phase evidence is a file of the template of the fixture (F141-FR-012), so it exists before the loop starts
scenarios.inScope: The same start-up decision as `103-empty-prompt`, and the one before it: F103-FR-006 states the two together, and the empty-prompt test runs only after this check. Without it the start-up of the pass loop has no scenario for its first branch
